execution: Staged real-device audit with user-handoff pauses; not a continuous multi-hour stress test

historical_root_companion_crash.inference: Old-APK classpath during upgrade/replacement is a plausible cause; exact upgrade transition was not reproduced in this audit

findings.name: Historical audio restore subprocess ClassNotFoundException/SIGABRT
findings.status: Before audit; old classpath path differs and is now absent. Upgrade transition root cause requires reproduction.

findings.name: Repeated target instrumentation disrupts ContentProvider lifecycle and sound lease
findings.status: Timeout cleanup improved; normal UI reopen restored sound; 129.42 seconds normal background healthy. Prefer a long-lived test session.

findings.name: Top control visual comparison lacks a visible OFF baseline
findings.status: Unverified; not classified as a confirmed product defect.

normal_native_initialization: Opening native billing initialized four default selection preferences; pre-existing choices were preserved.
User personally completed Gallery and Camera first-use agreements; the post-consent Camera baseline was preserved.
limitations: AOD shell-injected taps did not trigger physical black-screen callbacks; physical single/double tap and real ambient low-light behavior remain unverified.
WeChat is not installed, so no current-run real WeChat bill was tested; unsupported/native fallback was checked.
Air pause/play lists supported applications as not installed; only entry exposure was verified.
Top three-dot control was absent in the OFF baseline; hiding/restoration has no effective visual proof in this window path.
Cast encoder configured rates are verified; actual delivered 90/120 fps is not measured. Native source is already 1080x2376, so resolution caps did not resize; density on/off both yielded 480.
Actual weak-network throttling, true game-specific cast sessions, other ROMs and overnight endurance are not covered.
Bilibili and DragonRead are absent; audio panel/policy tests used owned synthetic fixtures.
Logcat rotates; this audit combines snapshots, staged scoped live PC logs, LSPosed logs, DropBox and exit history. No per-module disabling A/B isolation was performed.
next_work: Reproduce and harden audio companion teardown across APK replacement/upgrade.
Reduce repeated instrumentation target restarts; preserve explicit cleanup of MediaStore recycle-bin copies and audio tracking records.
Create a window path with a visible three-dot baseline before deciding on a product fix.
architecture_recommendation: Local hardening and test-driver cleanup; no evidence justifies a whole-project rewrite.
